title: Board Dividend Schedule: Termination Dividend at a Reduced Paid-Up Election on Whole Life Insurance
content:
**Product:** Whole Life Insurance (Ashgrove), including policies issued by conversion of an Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy.

## Schedule

A termination dividend is added at a reduced paid-up election for long continuous coverage on the insured, counted in whole months **to the date the election takes effect** from the issue date of the Ashgrove Term Life Insurance policy converted into this policy, or from this policy's own issue date when it was not issued by conversion:

| Whole months of continuous coverage | Never reinstated | Termination dividend |
|---|---|---|
| 360 or more | Yes | 3% (0.03) of the guaranteed cash value |
| 240 or more, below 360 | Yes | 1.5% (0.015) of the guaranteed cash value |
| Below 240 | Yes | None |
| Any | No | None |

The termination dividend is figured on the guaranteed cash value from the most recent anniversary statement and is rounded half up to the cent as the amount finally paid.

## Records read

- Whole life policy record: issue date, the converted term policy reference (empty for a new application), reinstatement date (empty if never reinstated), guaranteed cash value.
- Term Life Insurance policy record of the converted term policy: its issue date.

A whole month is counted each time the same day of the month as the start date is reached.

## Cases (hypothetical, guaranteed cash value 30000.00)

- Term Life Insurance issued October 1, 1995, converted 2005; election effective October 1, 2025; never reinstated: 360 months, termination dividend 900.00.
- Same, election effective September 15, 2025: 359 months, termination dividend 450.00.
- Whole life policy issued on application June 1, 2008: 207 months to an election effective September 1, 2025, no termination dividend.
